description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见如何保证幂等性。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence.
The regular expression for the configure permission.
The regular expression for the read permission.
The regular expression for the write permission.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun amqp-open create-open-source-permission --instance-id amqp-cn-v0h1kb9nu000 --user-name myName --vhost vhostName --configure '^' --write order_exchange --read '^' --client-token f6af6bb123988d191bfe01c9a9b --region cn-hangzhou
